payload.progression_strategy: Double progression within each exercise's assigned rep range per research.json's beginner progression finding: build up reps at a given load/variant before increasing difficulty. RPE guidance ramps from 6-7 in weeks 1-2 (motor learning priority) to 8 by weeks 7-8, with a planned deload in week 6.
